## Summary
Systems Engineer (UNIMINUTO) and Full-Stack Developer with ~2,500 commits across 11 production codebases for Australian digital agency Web Stark. Specializing in Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, enterprise WooCommerce plugin development, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO).

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Frontend:** Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, SCSS, Framer Motion, MDX, Velite.
- **Backend & CMS:** PHP 8.2+, WordPress Custom Plugin Architecture, WooCommerce Core Customization, WHMCS API, Node.js, GraphQL, MySQL.
- **AI & Automation:** Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers, Claude Code Skills & Agents, Python Automation (Trafilatura), AEO/GEO Search Optimization.
- **DevOps & Performance:** Docker, Docker Compose, Vercel, Core Web Vitals (Sub-second LCP, zero CLS), Jest Testing, Security Hardening (SEC-1..12).
